summary.whatChanges: Fixes mock registration ordering in Vitest's bare module mocker: pending mocks are now snapshotted and cleared up front, resolved in parallel, then applied strictly in queue order so the last `vi.doMock`/`vi.unmock` for a path wins. Adds an e2e test covering duplicate `doMock` calls for the same path.
behaviorChanges: Repeated vi.doMock calls for the same path without an import in between now consistently use the last registered factory instead of a race-dependent one
Mock/unmock application order matches the order the calls were queued, not the order their path resolution completed
The pending mock queue is cleared before resolution begins, so mocks queued during resolution are no longer discarded
risks: Clearing pendingIds before awaiting resolution changes reentrancy semantics; mocks queued mid-resolution are handled by a separate pass and could interleave differently than before
Tests that relied on the previous (resolution-order) mock application behavior may now produce different mocked modules
